title: Version 1.2.0 — New Filters & Adjustments for Painting & Animation Editor, Importer and Exporter (Beta)
markdown:
### Version 1.2.0 — New Filters & Adjustments for Painting & Animation Editor, Importer and Exporter (Beta)

#### Highlights & Changes:
* ## 🎬 Animation Player & Animation Studio Deck Overhaul (Beta)
* Expanded Animation Library & Categories: Ingests significantly more in-game animations across expanded tokenized categories.
* New Animation Studio Deck Editor.
* Dope Sheet View: Timeline ruler, master summary row, diamond keyframe glyphs, marquee multi-select, box snapping, and batch retiming.
* Graph Editor View: Interactive Bezier F-Curves for bone translation ($X, Y, Z$) and continuous Euler rotation (Roll, Pitch, Yaw) with Auto, Aligned, Vector, and Free tangent modes.
* F-Curve Modifiers: Procedural non-destructive curve modifiers including Noise, Cycles, Stepped, and Envelope / Limits.
* Auto-Keying & 3D Gizmo Integration: Manipulating bones via viewport gizmos automatically inserts keyframes at the active playhead frame (🔴 Auto-Key).
* Quick Tools & Key Actions: Pose copy/paste, pose mirroring, clip duration scaling, and instant GLB scene export.
* External Animation Importer & Retargeting System: import external humanoid animations (.glb, .gltf, .fbx) directly to replace character animations. Tested with Mixamo and Mesh2Motion character animations.
* Native VPK Animation Export (.vnmclip_c)
* 🎨 Texture Painting: New Filters, Adjustments & Clone Tool
* Advanced Color Adjustments: Gradient Map, Levels, Threshold & Posterize and Exposure & Color Balance
* Image Filter Suite: Blur, SHarpen, Pixelate, Stylize and Noise
* New Clone Stamp Tool: Sample source texels across 2D UV canvas and 3D mesh surfaces to clone, touch up, and blend character skin, clothing patterns, and textures.
* Normal Map & VTEX Alpha Preservation Fix: Resolved a critical issue where compiling textures stripped or corrupted the .vtex_c alpha channel.
* Material Archetype & Texture Format Detection: Added auto-detection for g_tAltColor_Reveal and g_tAltColor shader parameters.

history.title: Version 1.1.0-beta2 — New Painting Tweaking Menus, Diagnostic Tools & UI Fixes
highlights: → New Painting menu buttons for Tweaking (File & Adjustments)
A- Adjustments: Brightness, Contrast, Hue, Saturation, Lightness, Invert, and Color Balance with real-time layer preview.
B- File: Export Base Textures, enhanced PNG import pipeline, and more...
→ Eye-dropper & Line Shape tool icons updated.
→ New Custom Eye-Dropper.
→ Diagnostic Tool for tracking app activities and hardware. New "logs/" folder for generation of log files.
→ New Option in Settings/General for toggling log generation.
→ Attempt to fix Additive animations (emotes/reactions). Still WIP.

history.title: Version 1.1.0-beta — Painter Overhaul, Particle VFX Studio & Workspace (.dpp)
highlights: VPK Library updated to latest release 20.1, allowing correct hero loading.
Per-material native resolution painting architecture with material-grouped submesh hierarchy.
New 3D & 2D Shape Tools (Square, Circle, Line), Selection Mask Suite (Rectangular, Lasso, Polygonal), and interactive 3D/2D Transform Gizmos for Decals, Text, and Shapes.
Deterministic 3D CPU Particle VFX Simulator & Editor: paint particle textures and customize emitter Size, Alpha, Constant Color, Random Color Min/Max, and Color Fade with direct .vpcf_c VPK export.
Multi-asset Mod Workspace Session and unified .dpp project files preserving layers, blend modes, Extra Models, and VFX across multiple heroes.
Full Extra Models support for editing hero summons, weapons, and ability props.
Redesigned UI with illustrated sidebar buttons, visual card gallery modals (Heroes, Mods, Extra Models, Particle thumbnails).
Website release.

history.title: Version 1.0.1 — New Heroes & Topbar Menu
highlights: Added support for 6 new update heroes from models/heroes_wip/: Violet, Baba, Deadman Danny, Nurse Harrow, Ratking, and Solomon.
Highlighted the new WIP roster in the Hero Selection menu with dedicated badges.
Added update topbar menu and changelog viewing modal.

history.title: Version 1.0.0 — Initial Public Release
highlights: Native Valve pak01_dir.vpk archive reader and Source 2 binary parser (.vmdl_c, .vmat_c, .vtex_c, .vanim_c).
Real-time 3D CameraBrush texture painting and 2D UV canvas dock with non-destructive multi-layer stack.
Skeletal FK/IK posing suite with Gizmo3DSharp and procedural cloth simulation (Position-Based Dynamics).
Bespoke shaders for Infernus, Lady Geist, Viscous, Vindicta, Lash, Wraith and more heroes.
One-click direct mod export pipeline compiling custom skins into pak##_dir.vpk files directly in Citadel addons.
